content.short: STON.fi is the primary AMM DEX on the TON blockchain, featuring deep Telegram integration and gas-free trading.
content.description: STON.fi is the definitive decentralized exchange and automated market maker (AMM) built natively on The Open Network (TON). Designed for maximum accessibility, the platform is deeply integrated with the Telegram ecosystem, allowing users to execute trades and manage liquidity directly through a familiar messaging interface. STON.fi features a unique 'gasless' trading experience, where transaction fees are automatically deducted from the assets being swapped. Utilizing advanced cross-chain technology based on Hashed Timelock Contracts (HTLC), STON.fi provides a secure venue for exchange.
